explicit_boundaries: Not counted as a native HOT destination: original naming opcode is admitted through the typed observing one-opcode JS_AArch64Step route, returns to the same VM; captures.json, prepare_vm.py and captured-entry ON/OFF/descriptor/OOM fixtures bind this explicit boundary. The initial audit incorrectly added the x86-specific set_name destination to the 141 original base handlers.

ARM pure root/child call leaves have a compiler-owned 192-byte C activation; ordinary native JS frame calls/returns retain the single register-VM activation. Prepared callbacks and JSON keep the qualified capsule preference. Counterfactual routing optimality and x86 noncalling machine-code identity are not claimed.
MSVC-only native coroutine segments and extra-method learning, default-OFF weak VM links, and ordinary async output-capability elision absent from the accepted GNU baseline remain outside GNU parity.

Build CHECK/ABI receipts certify their local functional/image contracts. Their hardware_performance_qualified=false fields are not rewritten into unconditional performance certification; this report binds actual measurements separately.

decisions.item: Existing native implementation and conservative AUTO fallback
decisions.basis: Full mechanisms, functional/compatibility matrices and real hardware scores are bound. Native is explicit opt-in: strong JSON benefits coexist with material dispatch/call costs; PORTABLE remains a useful workload choice.

Retained prior experiment: about 25.5% targeted elapsed reduction; whole micro57 throughput 0.999052 original and 1.006594 elapsed diagnostic, with 6.56%, 5.90%, 4.39% selected elapsed regressions. Not promoted; raw per-case (candidate-prior)/stock costs and negative evidence remain external.

decisions.item: Dispatch/helper preservation and short-callback routing redesign
decisions.basis: Eight valid source/image-bound software-perf captures across both rounds identify real VM/C/helper activity. The lazy-collections original-body profile confirms a legacy generator/VM/call-leaf mix. Self-sample shares are not removable costs or an architectural ceiling; no layout/address search or unbounded optimization is required for this baseline release.
